description: Clip-lifetime mutants of the audio plan, killed only by an AddressSanitizer build of gyo_audio_tests (configure with -fsanitize=address, BUILD_TESTING=ON, no products, for example build/target/_build/audio-asan). Run with tests/common/mutation/run_mutations.py --catalog this file --build-dir <the ASan build>.

mutants.what: The audio thread hands a play's entry back as soon as it is taken, so the producer lets go of samples a voice still reads (the caller let go already). Takes over from au-ctl-clip-reuse-without-check-asan (clip slots are gone).
mutants.cases: *plays and lets go of clips while another thread renders*
